title: Enchanted Bedroom Material Atelier
description: A minimalistic modern bedroom serves as a material design studio where a decorative corset mannequin and a dragon sculpture sit on display. The user acts as a material artist, selecting each object and applying layered material transformations including roughness, metalness, emissive glow, opacity, color tint, and a special dispersion-inspired refraction effect, with real-time visual feedback and parameter validation.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (importmap with three and three/addons from cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0). Load three GLB assets using GLTFLoader: minimalistic_modern_bedroom.glb as the environment, Corset.glb placed on the bed or a surface as a decorative mannequin piece, and DragonDispersion.glb placed on a nightstand or shelf as a sculptural art object. Scale and position assets so they coexist naturally in the bedroom scene. Use a PerspectiveCamera at a 3/4 angle viewing the room, with OrbitControls for rotation (damping enabled, limited polar angle 10-80 degrees). Add an ambient light (intensity 0.4), a warm point light simulating a bedside lamp, and a directional light with soft shadows enabled on the renderer. Implement raycaster-based object selection: clicking the corset or dragon highlights it with an outline or emissive pulse. Build an HTML overlay panel (fixed, right side, styled dark semi-transparent) with these material controls, each validated to specific ranges: (1) Color Tint — HTML color picker, applied as mesh material color. (2) Roughness — slider 0.0-1.0, step 0.05, default 0.5. (3) Metalness — slider 0.0-1.0, step 0.05, default 0.0. (4) Emissive Intensity — slider 0.0-2.0, step 0.1, default 0.0, with emissive color matching tint. (5) Opacity — slider 0.1-1.0, step 0.05, default 1.0, enabling transparent mode when below 1.0. (6) Refraction Strength — slider 0.0-1.0 that interpolates the material's ior between 1.0 and 2.33 and sets transmission accordingly, simulating dispersion-like refraction. Each parameter change applies only to the currently selected object by traversing its meshes and updating MeshPhysicalMaterial properties. Validate all inputs: clamp out-of-range values, ignore NaN. Add a Reset Material button restoring defaults. Display the selected object name and current parameter values in the panel. The bedroom materials remain untouched. Ensure renderer uses tone mapping (ACESFilmic) and outputColorSpace sRGB for realistic appearance.
